title: Submerged: The Weight of Being
description: Map the physical and mental sensation of being 'weighted down'. Discover the somatic drag behind your emotional lows.

questions.text: Lately, my body feels like it's...

options.text: Light and energized.
Carrying a small backpack of bricks.
Moving through water up to my chest.
Pinned to the ground by an invisible weight.

questions.text: When the world gets loud or busy, I feel...

options.text: Fully able to engage.
I need to tune out occasionally.
Muffled; like I'm hearing life through glass.
Completely disconnected; I am too deep inside to hear anything.

questions.text: My ability to 'climb out' of a bad day is currently...

options.text: Strong and reliable.
A bit slow but I get there.
Non-existent; I just have to wait for it to end.
I haven't been 'out' of it in weeks.

insight_cloud.title: Leadened Paralysis
insight_cloud.text: In atypical depression journeys, 'Submerged' feelings are known as leadened paralysis. It's a physiological state where limbs feel heavy and moving takes immense cognitive effort.

questions.text: The simplest movements (brushing teeth, walking) feel...

options.text: Automatic and easy.
A little tedious.
Like a deliberate choice I have to force.
An exhausting uphill battle.

questions.text: Do you feel like you are 'drowning' even when everything on the surface looks fine?

options.text: No.
Occasionally.
Frequently.
Yes, I am staying afloat with zero margin for error.
